📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough Broadened `i18next` version ranges in three app package.json files, migrated pluralization keys across multiple locale translation JSONs to explicit CLDR categories (`_one` / `_other`) (and added `_one` variants), adjusted i18next-parser defaultValue behavior, and removed a `count` prop from a `Trans` call. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Package.json i18next Updates**
`apps/assisted-chatbot/package.json`, `apps/assisted-disconnected-ui/package.json`, `apps/assisted-ui/package.json`|Updated `i18next` dependency range from `^20.4.0` to `^20.4 || ^21`.| |**Translation File CLDR Migration**
`libs/locales/lib/en/translation.json`, `libs/locales/lib/es/translation.json`, `libs/locales/lib/fr/translation.json`, `libs/locales/lib/ja/translation.json`, `libs/locales/lib/ko/translation.json`, `libs/locales/lib/zh/translation.json`|Added or converted pluralization keys to CLDR-style `_one` / `_other` variants (replacing or supplementing previous `_plural` or unsuffixed keys) across many count-based UI strings and labels.| |**i18next parser config**
`libs/locales/.i18next-parser.config.cjs`|Replaced `useKeysAsDefaultValue: true` with `defaultValue: (_locale, _namespace, key, value) => value || key`.| |**Trans usage tweak**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/clusterConfiguration/DiscoveryInstructions.tsx`|Removed `count={+isSNO}` prop from a `Trans` component (other nearby `t(..., { count: +isSNO })` call unchanged).| |**UI text interpolation rename**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/cim/components/Hypershift/DetailsPage/NodePoolsTable.tsx`|Renamed interpolation variables in a Popover message: use `count` and `hosts` instead of `agents`/`count`, updating displayed phrasing.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes ## Possibly related PRs - openshift-assisted/assisted-installer-ui#3524 — Overlapping edits to locale translation JSONs with pluralization key changes. - openshift-assisted/assisted-installer-ui#3497 — Related changes to translation file generation/parser config and translation management rules. - openshift-assisted/assisted-installer-ui#3319 — Large-scale locale updates including pluralization/key migrations affecting the same files. ## Suggested labels `lgtm` ## Suggested reviewers - jkilzi - rawagner ## Poem > 🐰 I hopped through keys in morning light, > > `_one` and `_other` tucked in tight. > > Versions broadened, parser tuned with care, > > Trans props trimmed with a nimble flair, > > A little rabbit hop — i18n's bright and fair.

Skipping docstring coverage check. |
